retraction.reason: Retracted in M40b: the decade of upheaval Mao launched in May 1966. The atlas holds nothing in China between 1949 and 1999, and the link that would matter here is precise: the spill-over into Macau in December 1966, after which Portuguese authority in the territory was nominal and the question of returning it was open. No source this atlas holds carries that incident, so the edge would rest on nothing. It needs the 1-2-3 incident of 1966–67 as a record first.
